page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.7xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 32 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it offers a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates that the single-core performance of this instance is relatively weak, with stress-ng and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 25%, and single-threaded gzip compression scoring in the bottom 10%. However, the instance leverages its 32 dedicated cores to achieve average multi-core performance, as demonstrated by middle-tier results in stress-ng multi-core, PassMark CPU, and Geekbench multi-core tests. Memory bandwidth for both small and large blocks is average, though the PassMark memory score is positioned in the bottom 25%.

In terms of qualitative cost efficiency, the ecs.sn2.7xlarge offers a balanced resource density suitable for multi-threaded workloads that do not require high single-core speeds. It performs in the middle tier for database operations, Redis SET operations, and static web serving. Additionally, it handles prompt processing and text generation for small and medium language models at average speeds. This makes the instance appropriate for general-purpose workloads, multi-threaded web serving, and moderate database operations.
